text:
Asha L.: Hi folks — I handed in my resignation to Priya today. Last day will be 2026-03-19. A few tricky items: I'm on the US medical plan but my partner stays on our family plan and lives in another state. Also 401k rollover questions, a hotspot device leased via company, and RSU vest 2026-03-25. Can we coordinate timeline and device return?
Liam (People Ops): Sorry to see you go, Asha. Quick answers: COBRA notice from BenefitAdmin goes out within ~3 biz days; election is 60 days from mailing date. We can request the notice email go to your company inbox and confirm the mailing address. 401k rollover contact info can be sent — DM payroll for specifics. We'll open an offboard ticket.
Asha L.: For the hotspot  can IT arrange local pickup? I'm moving the week after my last day and can't ship from the new address.
Rae - IT: Hi Asha  we can schedule a courier pickup at your current address before you relocate. We'll send a prepaid label and pickup window. Please don't factory reset the hotspot; remove personal accounts. We'll revoke MDM once received.
Asha L.: Thanks. Also, can SSO be disabled EOD and GitHub tokens revoked next morning? I need a couple hours after EOD to hand over a migration job.
Rae - IT: Standard schedule ok: SSO disable 18:00 UTC on last day, GitHub/CI token revocation 07:00 UTC next morning. If you need a shift, tell us now.
Asha L.: That schedule works. Regarding RSU vest on 03/25  does leaving on 03/19 block it?
comp-admin: Vesting is based on your grant terms. Typically you must be employed on the vest date to receive it. I'll review your grant and send a confirmation email within 2 business days.
Nico (Payroll): Final pay will include prorated salary + payout for unused PTO (per policy). 401k: we can provide rollover forms and next steps; please DM your last 4 SSN and plan vendor and I'll start the paperwork. Any expense reimbursements in flight should be submitted by EOD this Friday to make the final run.
Marta (HR): COBRA note: if your partner is on the family plan, they'll be eligible for continuation as a qualified beneficiary. Election window starts when the notice is mailed. BenefitAdmin usually mails and emails; we'll request email copy right away.
BenefitAdmin: We'll email a COBRA election packet to asha.l@redwood.com within 48 hours and mail the hard copy to the address on file. If address needs changing, reply to this thread or DM HR.
Asha L.: Please mail to my current address (listed in Workday)  I moved recently. Also, can inbound mail be forwarded to Priya for 45 days and calendar remain visible to the team for 14 days?
Liam (People Ops): Yes to both. We'll set mailbox forwarding to Priya for 45 days and keep calendar visibility for 14 days. Adding that to the checklist.
Priya (Manager): I'll own the runbook handoff and schedule two KT sessions: 90 mins on 2026-03-16 and 60 mins on 2026-03-18 for final syncs. Please include runbook links and outstanding PRs.
Asha L.: Booked both KT slots and pushed a short PR checklist. Also I have an external SaaS billed to the company card  who should I transfer billing to?
Liam (People Ops): Add vendor + billing contact to the offboard ticket. We'll tag Finance & IT to move the subscription.
security-bot: Offboard ticket `OB-2026-451` created. Scheduled actions: SSO disable 2026-03-19T18:00:00Z, GitHub token revoke 2026-03-20T07:00:00Z, VPN cert revoke 2026-03-19T18:15:00Z, Workspace license suspend 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z.
Asha L.: One last question: who do I talk to about health insurance charges that might post after my last day? I want to make sure my partner isn't surprised.
Marta (HR): If charges post after termination, BenefitAdmin's COBRA team reconciles them. We'll also provide a contact for retrospective billing queries in the COBRA packet. I'll DM you the contact.
Asha L.: Great  thank you all. I'll watch for the COBRA email and the pickup label. If anything changes I'll update the ticket `OB-2026-451`. :heart:
